column1: # Pronunciation overrides for The Lessons of History.
# Applied as misaki inline overrides. Kokoro's notation: A=ay, I=eye,
# O=oh, W=ow, Y=oy, T=flap t. Stress mark goes before the stressed
# syllable. Matching is case-insensitive and covers possessives.
# Only entries Kokoro gets audibly wrong are listed; names it already
# Xerxes, Charlemagne, Descartes, Euphrates, Haydn) are left alone.
